+    def encode_ordinary(self, text):
+        """Encoding that ignores any special tokens."""
+        # split text into chunks of text by categories defined in regex pattern
+        text_chunks = re.findall(self.compiled_pattern, text)
+        # all chunks of text are encoded separately, then results are joined
+        ids = []
+        merge_items = tuple(self.merges.items())
+        cached = getattr(self, "_encode_ordinary_cache", None)
+        if cached is not None and cached[0] == merge_items:
+            merge_map = cached[1]
+            cache = cached[2]
+        else:
+            merge_map = build_merge_map(self.merges)
+            cache = {}
+            self._encode_ordinary_cache = (merge_items, merge_map, cache)
+        # identical chunks encode to identical ids, so each is encoded once
+        extend = ids.extend
+        for chunk in text_chunks:
+            chunk_ids = cache.get(chunk)
+            if chunk_ids is None:
+                chunk_bytes = chunk.encode("utf-8") # raw bytes
+                chunk_ids = self._encode_chunk(chunk_bytes, merge_map)
+                if len(cache) >= 8192:
+                    cache.clear()
+                cache[chunk] = chunk_ids
+            extend(chunk_ids)
+        return ids
+

actions.reason: Cache RegexTokenizer.encode_ordinary's merge map and encoded regex chunks on the tokenizer while the merges are unchanged. Reusing the cache across encode calls avoids rebuilding the merge lookup and re-encoding repeated chunks in repeated ordinary/special-token encodes without changing the produced ids.

diff --git a/minbpe/regex.py b/minbpe/regex.py
--- a/minbpe/regex.py
+++ b/minbpe/regex.py
@@ -295,15 +295,24 @@ class RegexTokenizer(Tokenizer):
         text_chunks = re.findall(self.compiled_pattern, text)
         # all chunks of text are encoded separately, then results are joined
         ids = []
-        merge_map = build_merge_map(self.merges)
+        merge_items = tuple(self.merges.items())
+        cached = getattr(self, "_encode_ordinary_cache", None)
+        if cached is not None and cached[0] == merge_items:
+            merge_map = cached[1]
+            cache = cached[2]
+        else:
+            merge_map = build_merge_map(self.merges)
+            cache = {}
+            self._encode_ordinary_cache = (merge_items, merge_map, cache)
         # identical chunks encode to identical ids, so each is encoded once
-        cache = {}
         extend = ids.extend
         for chunk in text_chunks:
             chunk_ids = cache.get(chunk)
             if chunk_ids is None:
                 chunk_bytes = chunk.encode("utf-8") # raw bytes
                 chunk_ids = self._encode_chunk(chunk_bytes, merge_map)
+                if len(cache) >= 8192:
+                    cache.clear()
                 cache[chunk] = chunk_ids
             extend(chunk_ids)
         return ids
